description:
A set of applications for accessing and controlling intimate haptics/sensor hardware.


Features
- Device command history display now less jank
  - Has axes!
  - Doesn't jank its way across the screen anymore!

Bugfixes
- Updated to Buttplug dependencies using btleplug v0.13.4
  - Should fix windows issues with dongles not connecting
- Fixes stop issue with OSSM
